svg.aria-label: Preserve the event and append a settled result interactive diagram
svg.desc: The immutable event survives both phases. Settlement-v2 requires a real before/after bracket and may narrow it with eligible overlapping envelopes. Evidence states are retained. Built with Archify Studio / Archify, MIT license.
